{{Quote|Nice move, fish-head.|The bounty hunter, reprimanding Dhidal Nyz|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''bounty hunter''' was hired in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] by [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and partnered with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dhidal Nyz]] to capture the fugitive [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a rampage through the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after coming down with an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic psychosis]]. During the chase, however, they were [[Laser/Legends|fired]] upon by ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The bounty hunters' vehicle, a [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]], was disabled, and the hunters were forced to give up the chase.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Two maladjusted want-to-be bounty hunters and their dressed-up protocol droid.|Horn, referring to the female bounty hunter, Nyz, and Vaxx|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
[[File:ValinHorn-G6Sketch.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The bounty hunter was among several hunters who were hired by Chief Daala to capture the Jedi Valin Horn (pictured).]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] took part in the manhunt for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]]<ref name="Outcast" /> in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].<ref name="Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM|quote=with FotJ starting at 43.5.}}</ref> Horn, who had recently developed an [[Force psychosis|enigmatic madness]] that caused him to believe that everybody he knew had been replaced with an impostor, had been taken to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] to be studied. However, he had quickly escaped and embarked on a destructive rampage through the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] issued a warrant for his arrest, and several beings&mdash;including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], bounty hunters, and [[Galactic Alliance Security]] agents&mdash;joined the chase. The Human bounty hunter was among the many hunters hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] to be a part of the Chief of State's [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]]. She was partnered with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] bounty hunter [[Dhidal Nyz]]. The three hunters rode in the bed of a [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]], which was [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Unidentified pilot (Valin Horn)|another being]].<ref name="Outcast" />

During the chase, Horn, who had been flying in an antique [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], was attacked by Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and forced to eject from the fighter. The cargo hauler maneuvered underneath the falling Horn and caught him in the cargo bed. The bounty hunters trained their weapons on the fugitive, but as Nyz ordered Horn to surrender, Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]]&mdash;also hoping to capture Horn&mdash;leaped down toward the cargo bed from a [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] above them. While the three hunters were distracted by Solo, Horn grabbed his [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] and jumped off the side of the hauler, rocketing away.<ref name="Outcast" />

Solo landed in the cargo bed, and Nyz fired his electric net gun at her. The net caught her and disabled her, causing her to fall over the edge of the hauler. Annoyed by his rash action, the female bounty hunter began to criticize Nyz. However, her denigration was cut short as a racing speeder shot by them, causing the hauler's pilot to veer to one side. The cargo bed tilted sharply, and Nyz was thrown off the vehicle. The female hunter fell but quickly went into an acrobatic roll and came to a safe stop at the cargo bed's low railing. As they began to accelerate back up to speed, they were [[Laser/Legends|fired]] upon by Jedi allies [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Vaxx was hit, and the cyborg was sent flying into the control cab of the hauler. Smoke began streaming out from the cab, and, with their vehicle disabled, the trio of hunters were forced to give up the chase. As Valin Horn was captured by Luke Skywalker, bounty hunters [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] and [[Kaddit]] caught up with them, but the Jedi agreed with Galactic Alliance Security to jointly detain Horn [[Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center|nearby]] without bounty hunter or [[Journalist/Legends|media]] presence.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
The bounty hunter remained composed when under pressure, although she was easily annoyed with the incompetence of her colleagues. Nevertheless, she willingly worked with a team of bounty hunters during the hunt for Valin Horn. She was also very athletic, and, during the chase, when their vehicle veered off to one side, she managed to turn her fall into a somersault and quickly recover her balance. The woman was tall and had [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
The Human female wore a black [[bantha-hide jacket]] decorated with several claws and teeth of different colors and sizes, which were sewn onto the jacket. She also carried a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]] as her weapon of choice during the hunt for Horn.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bounty hunter appears in the first novel of the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, [[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast|''Outcast'']], which was written by [[Aaron Allston]] and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Outcast" />
